sections.section: RULES - Punjab Superintendents of Police Service Rules 2008
sections.description:
PUNJAB SUPERINTENDENTS OF POLICE,
PUNJAB SUPERINTENDENTS OF POLICE,
SERVICE RULES 2008
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I
12th December, 2012]
No.
5417/EXEC-II, dated 12-11-2009.---In exercise of power conferred by Article 112
of the Police Order 2002, the Provincial Police Officer with the approval of
the Government is pleased to, make the following amendments in the Punjab
Superintendents of Police Service Rules, 2008:-
1. In
the said rules, in the Schedule-I, in Column 10 under the heading
"Training" after entry at Sr. Nos. i & ii the following proviso
shall be inserted:--
Provided
that;
DSsP
of the all the Branches who attain the age of 58 years or above would be
exempted from mandatory courses namely "Junior Command Course"
and "Specialized Technical
Course".
2. In
the Schedule-I, in Column 10 under the heading "Field Experience" Sr.
No: ii, after the word "Training Institutions" the following shall be
inserted:--
Investigation
Branch Punjab, CID and Legal Branch of Central Police Office Punjab.
